prompt:
Game map background for a 2D top-down RPG, 1536x1024 landscape (3:2), filling the whole frame edge to edge, no border.

CAMERA: high-angle bird's-eye view looking down at about 50 degrees, orthographic-looking like a classic JRPG / Stardew-style town map: NO vanishing point, NO perspective convergence, all vertical building edges parallel and pointing straight up the image, ground plane seen almost from above. Building fronts are visible as short facades along the top and side edges; we see their roofs foreshortened. Consistent scale: a doorway is about 60 px wide and 100 px tall, a person would be about 90 px tall (but draw NO people).

STYLE: hand-painted cartoon illustration in exactly the painting style of the attached reference map (clean dark ink outlines on every shape, soft painterly cel shading, natural proportions, rich but slightly muted colours, no chibi, no pixel art, no 3D render, no photo). Mood and palette from the attached stage backdrop: Cyberpunk underground city in the year 2086, night-blue shadows, rusty metal, corrugated sheet metal, cables, steam, wet ground with reflections, neon light in hot pink, cyan and violet, warm yellow window light as accent. Readable game art: the walkable ground is large, flat, clearly lit and uncluttered; props sit at the edges; strong value contrast between floor (walkable) and walls/props (blocking).

The attached images are references for painting style, camera angle, scale and colour ONLY. Do not copy their buildings or layout and do not draw any characters.

STRICT: no people, no figures, no animals, no silhouettes of persons, no readable text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks, no signature, no frame, no UI.

LOCATION: Follow the layout of the attached grey blockout sketch: light = walkable ground, dark = buildings/blocking, cyan = exits. The last attached image is only the floor-plan sketch, not its look (ignore its labels, they are not part of the picture). Interior room seen from above, cut-away walls on the top edge only, floor fills most of the image; keep the outer left and right 7 % of the image as plain dark wall so nothing important sits there. "Rudi's Diner", a cosy roadside diner built inside the long fuselage of a crashed old passenger airplane in the desert. The large walkable area is a checkered black-and-white diner floor running the whole length of the cabin, filling the middle and lower half of the image.
TOP WALL: the curved inner hull of the airplane with a row of round windows showing bright desert daylight, overhead luggage bins used as shelves with mugs, plates, ketchup bottles and jars of honey.
LEFT END: the old cockpit as Rudi's office: two pilot seats, the instrument panel with dead dials, a small desk with papers, framed photos of the crash pinned around it.
TOP CENTER: a long chrome diner counter with red bar stools in front of it, a cash register, a cake dome with a stack of pancakes, a coffee machine; behind it a narrow strip of floor for the cook.
TOP RIGHT: the small kitchen behind a pass-through window with a bell: a griddle, pans hanging, steam, a fridge; the kitchen is reachable through a swinging half-door at the end of the counter.
RIGHT HALF: a long table made from an airplane wing flap with many mismatched chairs (the negotiation table), a map of the desert under glass on it.
BOTTOM LEFT and BOTTOM RIGHT along the lower wall: booths made from old airplane passenger seats facing small tables, with seat belts still hanging.
BOTTOM CENTER-RIGHT: a glowing retro jukebox with bubbling colour tubes - the most eye-catching spot.
BOTTOM CENTER edge: the open cabin door with a few steps - the exit, bright desert daylight falling in.
Light: warm yellow lamps, pink and turquoise neon tubes along the ceiling edge, dusty daylight through the round windows. Cosy, greasy, funny.
